## Pitch

OpenShouter reads the alerts you choose — out loud — so you do not have to look at the phone. That helps people who cannot see a screen, or cannot read what is on it. It also helps anyone who wants the device to stay in a pocket.

Silence ringtones and notification sounds. In OpenShouter, allow only the apps you still need to hear. The rest stays quiet. You keep the important calls and messages, drop the noise, and glance at the screen far less.

It is a FOSS Android announcer inspired by Voice Notify and classic Shouter: spoken notifications, looping caller ID, battery and power events, mute gestures, and on-device geofences. No Google Play Services, Firebase, or tracking. MIT licensed. GitHub Releases only.

## Features

- Eyes-free by design: hear callers and chosen notifications when you cannot see or read the screen
- Quieter days: mute system sounds, whitelist the apps that matter, and stop checking the phone all day
- Notification TTS with per-app filters, format strings, and regex ignore/replace
- Looping caller ID that stops when you answer, reject, or miss the call
- Shake, flip face-down, or turn the screen on or off to stop a shout; quiet hours and headset-only when you need silence
- On-device only — local history, no Play Services, no tracking; MIT; GitHub Releases

## Quick start

1. Download the APK from GitHub Releases (not listed on Play Store or F-Droid).
2. Enable Notification access. Grant phone, contacts, and location only if you use those shouts.
3. Put ringtones and notification sounds on silent. In OpenShouter, whitelist only the apps you still want spoken.
4. Keep the phone away. Shake or flip to stop a shout. Use quiet hours when you want none.

## Install

Users: install the APK from GitHub Releases. Developers: JDK 17 and Android SDK (compile/target 35, min 26). Clone the repo, open `examples/android/`, and run `./gradlew assembleDebug` (or `gradlew.bat` on Windows). No Play Services.

## Usage

Treat OpenShouter as the voice of a silent phone. System ringer and notification sounds stay off. OpenShouter speaks only the apps and events you enable (calls, notifications, battery, places). Master mute is on the dashboard, Quick Settings tile, and home-screen widget. Contributors work from `BUILD_PLAN.md` and `docs/START_HERE.md`.

## Configuration

Copy [`.env.example`](../../.env.example) to `.env` for local secrets (never commit `.env`). Stack-specific config lives in the active `examples/` or app root after prune.
